hooks.name: Identity Verification Hook
hooks.description: Verifies agent identity on session start

action.prompt:
Read .kiro/steering/00-identity.md. Check the AGENT_ID value.

If AGENT_ID is "<REPLACE_ME>" or empty:
- STOP immediately
- Tell the human: "AGENT_ID not set. Run scripts/set-identity.sh first."
- Do not proceed with any work

If AGENT_ID is set:
- State your AGENT_ID and current machine
- Check if there are any active tasks assigned to you
- If yes, mention them
- Proceed with work

Always verify identity before starting any task.
